Why Control D

Five reasons teams switch and stay.

99.98%malware block rate, independently testedVerified by Nexxwave, 2025

Highest block rate among the public resolvers Nexxwave tested. Real-time AI catches malicious domains before they hit a shared blocklist.

Every OS, no workarounds

Native clients for Mac, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android. One policy across all of them.

Priced per endpoint

No minimums, no annual lock-in. SIEM streaming and API access on every plan.

Silent install and updates

Installs once and stays out of the way. Barry handles non-critical troubleshooting around the clock.

SOC 2 evidence, ready to export.

30-day query logs on every plan, plus a year of analytics. Export the proof instead of explaining why you can't.

AI Agent Security

Your AI agents need the internet. Not all of it.

Give AI agents access to the destinations they need and block everything they don’t. Control D puts DNS-level guardrails around agent internet access, with customizable policies and full visibility into every lookup.

Explore AI Agent Security

Deployment

Deploy today. Forget about it tomorrow.

1

Sign up.

No credit card required. No discovery call. No kickoff meeting.

2

Deploy.

Agent installs silently. Most customers go from sign-up to active filtering in minutes. Network-level deployment requires no agent at all.

3

Done.

Policies push without touching individual machines. Barry handles non-critical troubleshooting 24/7. Nobody gets paged for a DNS filtering issue.

Supports DNS-over-HTTPS/3, DNS-over-TLS, DNS-over-QUIC, and Do53 (DNS over port 53). Encrypted by default.

Next step

Need help planning the rollout?

Every environment is different. If you’re migrating from another DNS provider, managing multiple clients, or working through deployment questions, we’re happy to help map out what switching to Control D would actually look like.
15 minutes. No sales pitch. Just practical answers.

Built for your environment

For IT & Security Teams

You’re doing SOC 2, managing laptops in 14 countries, and your engineering team runs Mac and Linux. Most DNS tools were built for Windows and bolted support on later. The gaps show up during audits.

Control D runs natively on every OS your team uses. One policy. 30-day query logs. Independent block rate. Your auditor gets what they need without you building it from scratch.

See our security and trust certifications

For MSPs

If you’ve spent a weekend fixing a DNS client after an update, you already know why MSPs switch. DNSFilter’s roaming client has a documented history of breaking on update and requiring manual remediation across client machines.

Control D installs silently, updates seamlessly and manages every client from one dashboard. Multi-tenant by design. Full API and CLI.

See how multi-tenancy works
